description: TRON chain economics straight off our node: energy price (sun per energy unit), transaction fee, account creation fee, witness pay per block, total energy and bandwidth limits, maintenance interval and the next maintenance time, unfreeze delay. When to use: working out what a transaction will actually cost in TRX, or how TRON's resource market is currently priced. Do not use: for Bitcoin fees (btc_get_fee_rates) or Monero fees (xmr_get_fee_rates). Returns: energy_fee_sun_per_unit, transaction_fee_sun, create_account_fee_trx, witness_pay_per_block_trx, maintenance_interval_s, next_maintenance_ms, unfreeze_delay_days, latest_energy_price.
name: tron_get_chain_economics
title: Tron Get Chain Economics
